supplements.title: Unlocking p-coumaric acid's potential against biofilm-forming extensively drug-resistant Acinetobacter baumannii: in vitro and in vivo study.
supplements.summary: P-coumaric acid successfully breaks down dangerous bacterial biofilms and restores antibiotic effectiveness against drug-resistant Acinetobacter baumannii infections.

supplements.title: Synergistic anticancer effects of peanut hairy root culture crude extract in combination with gemcitabine against cholangiocarcinoma.
supplements.summary: Peanut extract combined with gemcitabine effectively kills cholangiocarcinoma cancer cells and shrinks tumors in mice.

supplements.title: Yixinyuan Gaofang ameliorates myocardial infarction in rats by inhibiting the TNF/NF-κB pathway.
supplements.summary: A Chinese herbal medicine reduced heart attack damage in rats by suppressing inflammation and oxidative stress through the TNF/NF-κB pathway.

supplements.title: Fortified Chestnut Honey Triggers Apoptosis in Colon Cancer Cells.
supplements.summary: Fortified chestnut honey kills colon cancer cells while sparing normal cells, suggesting potential as a complementary cancer therapy.

supplements.title: Daklakamitocins A-I, Brominated Maytansinoid Glycosides from Amycolatopsis sp. CK6 with Antiproliferative Activity.
supplements.summary: Brominated compounds from bacteria show stronger cancer cell-killing activity than their chlorinated counterparts, suggesting bromine enhances effectiveness.

supplements.title: Celastrol inhibits the immune escape and proliferation of triple - negative breast cancer (TNBC) through the LKB1 - AMPK - PD-L1/MYC signaling pathway.
supplements.summary: Celastrol, a natural compound, stops triple-negative breast cancer growth and helps the immune system attack tumors by blocking a specific cellular pathway.

supplements.title: NCOA4-mediated ferritinophagy: emerging role and novel therapeutic target in precision oncology.
supplements.summary: NCOA4-mediated ferritin breakdown triggers iron-dependent cancer cell death, offering a new treatment strategy to overcome drug resistance.

supplements.title: Fish consumption and brain structure: a comprehensive systematic review of observational studies.
supplements.summary: Fish consumption may help preserve brain structure and slow age-related brain changes that lead to cognitive decline.

supplements.title: 3-Formylchromone attenuates urethane-induced lung carcinogenesis and enhances gefitinib anti-tumor response via modulation of IL-6/JAK1/STAT3/cyclin D1 signaling.
supplements.summary: 3-Formylchromone combined with gefitinib effectively reduces lung cancer tumors by blocking a key growth signaling pathway.

supplements.title: Mechanism of Asiatic acid against oesophageal squamous cell carcinoma: integration of network pharmacology and experimental validation.
supplements.summary: Asiatic acid fights esophageal cancer by targeting the PTGS2 protein and blocking a key growth pathway, reducing tumors in studies.

supplements.title: Network Pharmacology, Molecular Docking, Hematological Evaluation, and In Vivo Evidence Support Sakuranetin as a Redox and Inflammation-Modulating Agent Against Skin Tumorigenesis.
supplements.summary: Sakuranetin, a plant compound, protected mice from chemically-induced skin cancer by reducing harmful inflammation and oxidative stress.

supplements.title: Network pharmacology and molecular docking reveal the therapeutic mechanism of Hedyotis diffusa in esophageal squamous cell carcinoma: A bioinformatics analysis.
supplements.summary: Hedyotis diffusa herb compounds, particularly quercetin and beta-sitosterol, may treat esophageal squamous cell carcinoma by targeting cancer-related genes and MAPK signaling pathways.

supplements.title: Potential Role of PVP/Poloxamer 407 Nanofibers Loaded with Resveratrol Nanocrystals in Skin Cancer Therapy.
supplements.summary: Resveratrol nanofibers effectively reduced skin cancer tumor growth and symptoms in mice better than standard drug formulations.

supplements.title: S100A14 in Tumor-Derived EVs Targets PIAS3 to Reprogram Astrocytes and Induce Immunosuppressive Microenvironment Promoting Brain Metastasis and Germacrone Reversal Effect.
supplements.summary: S100A14 in tumor-derived particles promotes brain metastasis in lung and breast cancer; germacrone blocks this process effectively.

supplements.title: Network pharmacology, molecular docking, and In Vitro evaluation of morin against gastric cancer.
supplements.summary: Morin, a natural plant compound, effectively kills gastric cancer cells by targeting and blocking key growth-promoting proteins.

off_label.title: NCOA4-mediated ferritinophagy: emerging role and novel therapeutic target in precision oncology.
off_label.summary: NCOA4-mediated ferritin breakdown triggers iron-dependent cancer cell death, offering a new treatment strategy to overcome drug resistance.

off_label.title: Targeting CB1 and TRPM8 receptors to counteract CD8+ T cell exhaustion.
off_label.summary: Blocking CB1 receptors reduced exhaustion markers on immune cells, potentially improving cancer treatment effectiveness.

off_label.title: Pharmacological Treatments for Cancer-Related Anorexia-Cachexia Syndrome: An Umbrella Review of Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses.
off_label.summary: Researchers reviewed treatments for cancer-related appetite loss and muscle wasting, evaluating which drugs work best to help patients maintain weight.

off_label.title: Low-Dose Aspirin and Central Presbycusis: A Substudy of the ASPREE Randomized Clinical Trial.
off_label.summary: Low-dose aspirin may help slow age-related hearing loss in older adults by reducing inflammation and blood vessel problems.

off_label.title: Protective effect of nebivolol on bleomycin-induced lung fibrosis via suppressing TLR4/IL-1β/MMP-2 and TGF-β/HSP47 signaling pathways in rats.
off_label.summary: Nebivolol, a heart medication, protected rat lungs from bleomycin-induced scarring by blocking harmful inflammatory and fibrosis pathways.

off_label.title: Interconnection between Polycystic Ovary Syndrome, Immune Disorders, and Reproductive Outcomes.
off_label.summary: PCOS involves chronic inflammation and immune dysfunction that damage ovarian function and reduce pregnancy success, suggesting immune-targeted treatments could help.

off_label.title: Plasmin promotes hepatocellular carcinoma invasion and metastasis via CXCR4-mediated activation of PI3K/AKT/mTOR signaling.
off_label.summary: Plasmin promotes liver cancer invasion and metastasis; blocking it with tranexamic acid suppresses tumor spread and enhances chemotherapy effectiveness.

off_label.title: Metformin treatment impairs the adenine nucleotide translocator activity and energy metabolism in human clear cell renal carcinoma cells.
off_label.summary: Metformin kills kidney cancer cells by disrupting their energy production and forcing them to switch to less efficient metabolism.

off_label.title: Targeting G3BP1-Mediated Stress Granules to Suppress SARS-CoV-2 Replication.
off_label.summary: Two FDA-approved drugs, dexlansoprazole and citalopram, reduced SARS-CoV-2 replication by disrupting viral-host protein interactions in stress granules.

off_label.title: Liver cancer-derived exosomal PTK6 induces the secretion of pulmonary CHI3L1 to facilitate lung metastatic niche formation.
off_label.summary: Liver cancer cells send signals that trigger lung cells to produce a protein enabling lung metastasis; blocking this protein reduces cancer spread.

off_label.title: Targeting NDUFS4 Disrupts Oxidative Phosphorylation and Induces Ferroptosis in Olaparib-Resistant Prostate Cancer.
off_label.summary: Blocking NDUFS4 in drug-resistant prostate cancer restores sensitivity to PARP inhibitors by disrupting energy production and triggering cell death.

off_label.title: Dexamethasone for Chemotherapy-Induced Nausea and Vomiting Prevention in Pediatric Patients: International Consensus.
off_label.summary: Experts created guidelines on when dexamethasone safely prevents chemotherapy nausea in children, weighing its benefits against risks.

off_label.title: Multimodal Management of Ulcerated Infantile Hemangioma With Beta Blockers and Laser Therapy-A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
off_label.summary: Combined beta-blocker and laser therapy may heal ulcerated infantile hemangiomas faster than beta-blockers alone, but evidence remains inconclusive.

off_label.title: Antidiabetic drug effects on gastrointestinal health: convergent evidence from a longitudinal cohort and Mendelian randomization study.
off_label.summary: A diabetes drug shows potential protective effects on gastrointestinal health based on combined evidence from patient studies and genetic analysis.

off_label.title: Off-label intravitreal eculizumab for geographic atrophy: report of the first two cases.
off_label.summary: Researchers tested an eye injection drug to slow vision loss from age-related macular degeneration in two patients, showing early safety promise.

biomarkers.title: A systematic assessment of the short- and long-term effects of commonly used breast cancer chemotherapeutics on the gut microbiome‒blood‒brain axis of female mice.
biomarkers.summary: Breast cancer chemotherapies paclitaxel and cisplatin most disrupt the gut microbiome-brain axis, potentially benefiting from targeted interventions.

biomarkers.title: Endocrine and metabolic features of PTEN hamartoma tumor syndrome in childhood: a pediatric case series.
biomarkers.summary: PTEN hamartoma tumor syndrome in children causes varied symptoms and complications, making early diagnosis challenging.

biomarkers.title: A simplified multitarget stool test for colorectal cancer and advanced precancerous lesion detection.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers developed a simpler stool test using three markers to detect colorectal cancer and precancerous growths more easily.

biomarkers.title: Multimodal gene and targeted drug therapy for chronic myelogenous leukemia using BIM/MCL-1 chimeric nanoparticle: computational target analysis and therapeutic validation.
biomarkers.summary: Nanoparticles delivering two genetic therapies combined with a targeted drug effectively killed chronic myeloid leukemia cells in mice.

biomarkers.title: Scalable Quantum Non-Local Neural Network Optimized with Tyrannosaurus Algorithm for Brain tumor Detection using MRI Images.
biomarkers.summary: A new AI framework detects brain tumors in MRI scans with 99.8% accuracy, outperforming existing methods.

biomarkers.title: Geographic and Sex Distribution of LI-RADS Research Globally: A Cross-Sectional Meta-Research Study.
biomarkers.summary: LI-RADS research on liver cancer diagnosis doesn't match the actual global disease burden and male predominance.

biomarkers.title: Continuous bed motion versus step-and-shoot acquisition in LAFOV PET/CT: insights from multi-phantom and patient studies.
biomarkers.summary: Continuous bed motion scanning produces equal image quality to traditional step-and-shoot methods in advanced PET/CT cancer imaging.

biomarkers.title: MR-based techniques for imaging prostate cancer metabolism: current status and future perspectives.
biomarkers.summary: MR-based metabolic imaging techniques help diagnose, stratify risk, and monitor treatment response in prostate cancer.

biomarkers.title: Impact of TOPAZ-1 eligibility on the survival benefit of durvalumab plus gemcitabine-cisplatin in advanced biliary tract cancer: a multicenter real-world study.
biomarkers.summary: A combination drug treatment for advanced biliary tract cancer works well in real-world patients, not just trial participants.

biomarkers.title: Proteomic Analysis of Paired FFPE Tissue and Extracellular Vesicles Reveals Proteins Associated with Recurrence in Stage II Colorectal Cancer.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers identified specific proteins in tissue and blood vesicles that predict which stage II colorectal cancer patients will experience recurrence, enabling better risk assessment.

biomarkers.title: Transforming tumor cells into professional antigen-presenting cells using poly(β-amino ester) nanoparticles to deliver CD80-encoding mRNA.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers converted melanoma and lung cancer cells into immune-activating cells using nanoparticles delivering CD80 genes, enabling strong anti-tumor T-cell responses.

biomarkers.title: Isolated Mental Nerve Neuropathy as the First Clinical Sign of Nodal Marginal Zone Lymphoma: A Diagnostic Challenge.
biomarkers.summary: Persistent chin numbness was the first sign of marginal zone lymphoma, highlighting the importance of thorough investigation when symptoms don't resolve.

biomarkers.title: CMML2AML: machine-learning discovery of co-mutations and specific single mutations predictive of blast transformation in chronic myelomonocytic leukemia.
biomarkers.summary: Machine learning identified specific gene mutation combinations that predict which CMML patients will progress to acute leukemia, improving risk assessment.

biomarkers.title: Differential KEAP1/NRF2 mediated signaling widens the therapeutic window of redox-targeting drugs in SCLC therapy.
biomarkers.summary: SCLC cells' weak antioxidant defenses make them vulnerable to a TXNRD1 inhibitor, which can be safely escalated by boosting NRF2 protection in healthy tissues.

biomarkers.title: Methylation biomarkers in non-regressive cervical intraepithelial neoplasia grade 2 lesions: an epigenome wide association study.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers identified DNA methylation patterns that could predict which cervical precancerous lesions will persist rather than naturally disappear.

trials.title: A simplified multitarget stool test for colorectal cancer and advanced precancerous lesion detection.
trials.summary: Researchers developed a simpler stool test using three markers to detect colorectal cancer and precancerous growths more easily.

trials.summary: Nanoparticles delivering two genetic therapies combined with a targeted drug effectively killed chronic myeloid leukemia cells in mice.

trials.summary: A combination drug treatment for advanced biliary tract cancer works well in real-world patients, not just trial participants.

trials.summary: Researchers converted melanoma and lung cancer cells into immune-activating cells using nanoparticles delivering CD80 genes, enabling strong anti-tumor T-cell responses.

trials.summary: Persistent chin numbness was the first sign of marginal zone lymphoma, highlighting the importance of thorough investigation when symptoms don't resolve.

trials.summary: SCLC cells' weak antioxidant defenses make them vulnerable to a TXNRD1 inhibitor, which can be safely escalated by boosting NRF2 protection in healthy tissues.

trials.title: Waning of measles immunity by 5 years of age following an accelerated two-dose measles vaccine schedule at 6 and 12 months in South African children: an observational cohort study.
trials.summary: Children vaccinated against measles at 6 and 12 months showed declining immunity by age 5, raising concerns about accelerated vaccine schedules.

trials.title: An integrative molecular map of pediatric B-cell precursor acute lymphoblastic leukemia.
trials.summary: Researchers created a comprehensive molecular map of pediatric B-cell leukemia to better understand how different molecular factors affect treatment response.

trials.title: Proteome profiles of esophageal squamous cell carcinoma tie mitochondrial complex I to immunotherapy.
trials.summary: High mitochondrial complex I protein expression predicts better immunotherapy response in esophageal squamous cell carcinoma patients.

trials.title: Identification of an immune-metabolic biosignature linking depressive symptoms and breast cancer in a clinical population.
trials.summary: Researchers identified a blood-based signature combining BMI, immune, and metabolic markers that predicts depression risk in breast cancer patients, enabling early intervention.

trials.title: PARP inhibition with olaparib and talazoparib for HER2-negative advanced breast cancer-Results from the prospective PRAEGNANT registry.
trials.summary: PARP inhibitors olaparib and talazoparib showed comparable real-world effectiveness to clinical trials for HER2-negative advanced breast cancer with BRCA mutations.

trials.title: Deep learning-based automated masseter muscle area on routine CT stratifies survival in oral cancer.
trials.summary: A deep learning tool measuring masseter muscle size on CT scans predicts survival outcomes in oral cancer patients.

trials.title: Synergistic anticancer effects of peanut hairy root culture crude extract in combination with gemcitabine against cholangiocarcinoma.
trials.summary: Peanut extract combined with gemcitabine effectively kills cholangiocarcinoma cancer cells and shrinks tumors in mice.

trials.title: Co-delivering macrophage engager mRNA and PD-L1 antibody via tumor-responsive nanoparticles for glioblastoma immunotherapy.
trials.summary: Researchers developed tumor-targeting nanoparticles delivering mRNA and antibodies that reprogram immune cells to attack glioblastoma, improving survival without toxicity.

trials.title: MRI-Based Habitat Analysis for Predicting Pathologic Complete Response to Neoadjuvant Chemotherapy in Breast Cancer: A Multicenter Study.
trials.summary: MRI scans analyzing tumor structure can predict which breast cancer patients will have complete response to pre-surgery chemotherapy.

mind_body.title: Dehydration in the Dying Process: An Integrative Systematic Review of Physiological Mechanisms and Clinical Implications.
mind_body.summary: Terminal dehydration in dying patients is an adaptive process; artificial hydration increases respiratory secretions and discomfort without clear benefits.

mind_body.title: Pilot study of the DeStress for Health Program: a community-engaged stress reduction and cancer prevention intervention for rural communities.
mind_body.summary: A stress-reduction program showed promise in helping rural communities adopt healthier behaviors that could lower cancer risk.

mind_body.title: AI-enabled psychometric and psychophysiological assessment in psychiatric comorbidity of oncology patients: A systematic review.
mind_body.summary: AI tools can better detect depression and anxiety in cancer patients by continuously monitoring psychological distress beyond traditional screening methods.

mind_body.title: Association of postoperative psychological interventions on compliance and survival in breast cancer patients: A single-center retrospective study.
mind_body.summary: Early structured psychological support after breast cancer surgery significantly improved patient adherence to hormone therapy and showed survival benefits.

mind_body.title: Communication skill training in surgical residency: insights from Y-SICO (Young-Italian Society of Surgical Oncology).
mind_body.summary: Most surgical residents lack formal communication training despite recognizing its importance for delivering difficult diagnoses and managing patient care.

mind_body.title: Beyond tumor biology: nursing interventions for psychological and immune health in cancer patients.
mind_body.summary: Nursing interventions combining therapy, mindfulness, and lifestyle support improve psychological well-being and immune function in cancer patients.

mind_body.title: Breast cancer survivor and body: Exploring self-defining memories in an intervention pilot study.
mind_body.summary: A new psychological intervention helps breast cancer survivors process traumatic body-related memories and improve well-being.

mind_body.title: Five-Element Music and VR for Pain and Psychological Distress in Advanced Cancer: A Randomized Trial.
mind_body.summary: Music therapy and virtual reality together reduced pain and psychological distress in advanced cancer patients more effectively than standard care alone.

mind_body.title: Digital and AI-enhanced psychosocial interventions in breast cancer patients: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
mind_body.summary: Digital and AI-based mental health programs help reduce stress and anxiety in breast cancer patients, improving their overall well-being.

mind_body.title: How does self-compassion affect posttraumatic adaptation among lymphoma patients? A perspective based on network analysis.
mind_body.summary: Self-compassion components distinctly influence posttraumatic stress and growth differently in lymphoma patients through network analysis.

mind_body.title: A National Needs Assessment Identifies Training Gap in Integrative Oncology Education.
mind_body.summary: Most cancer doctors want integrative oncology training, but educational programs remain limited, creating a significant nationwide training gap.

mind_body.title: [Experience and access to acupuncture in patients undergoing anticancer treatment: A multicentric cross-sectional cohort study].
mind_body.summary: Cancer patients undergoing treatment rarely access acupuncture for managing side effects, despite reporting interest in this complementary therapy option.

mind_body.title: Association of marital and parental status with stress, support, adherence, and quality of life among breast cancer women.
mind_body.summary: Marital and parental status significantly influence stress levels, emotional support, treatment compliance, and quality of life in breast cancer patients.

mind_body.title: Early repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation for preventing chronic postoperative pain in older adults: a randomized clinical sub-study.
mind_body.summary: Early brain stimulation therapy reduced chronic pain after lung cancer surgery in older adults.

mind_body.title: Exploring the underlying structural mechanisms and whole-person perspectives on the desire for hastened death in patients with terminal cancer: A qualitative study.
mind_body.summary: Palliative care professionals identified structural factors driving terminal cancer patients' desire for hastened death.
